notes.title: [Father's Day] Father's Day mini-event update!
notes.notes:
Aaahhh!!!
It's Father's Day!!!
Fathers' Day!!! Thank you, fathers!
The Katsusada Institute supports fathers who protect their children!

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FyLRWsIaUAAAvSS?format=jpg&name=medium
I was going to do just a commemorative illustration,
I suddenly decided to tell the story of Mio's two fathers and updated the mini event.
In addition, there are a large number of updates that are mini-minis!

Below are the updates.

■ Achievements
The following updates have been made: - Achievements can now be obtained when you click on seasonal events.
Father (Mio) has been added to the Achievements icon.

Nusumigiki Map
The Father's Day mini-event Father's Tasks!
Nusumigiki DOREI-kun 5
Nusumigiki Father 3, 9, 10, 11
Scenario title added before story playback.

Others
PV to be shown at the Tokyo Game Dungeon.
